Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. We can support an audit-log excision for a single conversation, but there are a few steps we need to follow to comply with our security and legal requirements. Summary and next steps below:

1) Clarify exact artifacts to remove: please confirm the Redwood conversation/thread id (if available), the mailbox owner on your side, and the message timestamps (you provided rough UTC window — exact timestamps help us scope the cache/kv entries).

3) Compliance review: we will route the request to Security & Compliance (aditya_rao is our point) for an internal approval — typical review is 1 business day.
4) Execution window: once approved and we have the DRA + exact thread id, expected turnaround is 3–5 business days for audit log excision and evidence package. If this needs to be escalated, let me know and I will request priority handling.

Please upload the signed DRA here: https://support.redwood.ai/cases/EW-3421 (you can attach the form directly to the case). Also include a preferred point of contact for any follow-up (I copied Laura on this thread).
